title: Feedback Receipt
description: Receipt produced after Feedback writes a feedback item. Lightweight — feedback is low-ceremony.

feedback_id.description: ID of the written feedback item.

feedback_path.description: Path to the written feedback-{timestamp}.json file.

module_named.description: Whether the human named a specific module (false if module: unknown).

receipt_ref_provided.description: Whether the human provided a receipt reference.

duplicate_checked.description: Whether existing open feedback was scanned for duplicates before writing.

potential_duplicate_ids.description: Feedback IDs of similar open items surfaced during duplicate check.
